1. **First reaction:** This is a **pinacol rearrangement**. The vicinal diol **2,7-dimethyloctahydronaphthalene-4a,8a-diol** is protonated by sulfuric acid, loses water, and undergoes C–C bond migration with carbonyl formation. This rearranges the fused bicyclic system into the spirocyclic ketone, **2,8-dimethylspiro[4.5]decan-6-one**. A monohydric spiro alcohol could not undergo this transformation without an additional oxidant.

2. **Second reaction:** This is a **[1,2]-Wittig rearrangement**. BuLi generates the benzylic carbanion from **benzyl prenyl ether**, \(((\text{3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl})\text{oxy})\text{methyl})\text{benzene}\). Migration of the prenyl group gives the alkoxide  
   \[
   \mathrm{PhCH(O^-)CH_2CH=C(CH_3)_2},
   \]
   which is protonated to form **4-methyl-1-phenylpent-3-en-1-ol**. The ketone alternative would instead undergo BuLi addition and incorporate a butyl group.

Answer: C
